name: Find My Son
summary: The butler's spirit asks the party to find his son, who lived through the night the Lockwoods died.

stages.journal: The spirit that answered us on the board gave one last message before he fell silent: find his son, who lives. His name is Patrini.
stages.hint: Ask around Wickermoor Village for the name Patrini.

stages.journal: We spoke the name Patrini in front of the right man, and something old and lost moved behind his eyes. Joseph's son has been found.
